description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover the required 6-part structure (Opening, Interpretation, Comparison to Literature, Implications, Limitations, Conclusion) and the Draft→Revise checklist loop.
2. The agent reads project/manuscript/research_brief.md to extract the research question, all 4 key results (TMT-B, Stroop, age interaction, null gender finding), and the 3 prior literature references.
3. The agent drafts the discussion with all 6 labeled sections following the skill's recommended structure.
4. Critically, the agent uses the skill's proprietary 3-part limitations template (Limitation: / Impact: / Mitigation / Future direction:) for each of the three PI-noted limitations.
5. The agent applies the Draft→Revise checklist: verifying hedged language (suggests, indicates, may reflect), ensuring all 4 findings are addressed (including the null p=0.41 result), confirming no new data is introduced, and ensuring the conclusion ties back to the research question.
6. All three literature references (Harrison & Horne 2000, Lim & Dinges 2010, Wimmer et al. 2012) must appear in context.
7. The final file is saved at project/manuscript/discussion_section.md.
